cookies.instruction: Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things.
Do not lie to one another
cookies.reason: you have taken off the old self with its practices

cookies.instruction: clothe yourselves with hearts of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience.
cookies.reason: as the elect of God, holy and beloved

cookies.instruction: Bear with one another and forgive any complaint you may have against someone else.
